WELCOME TO THE INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL OF KENYA
A World-Class School Full of Opportunities

The International School of Kenya (ISK) is one of the leading international schools in East Africa, known for its culture of excellence, exceptional care, and boundless opportunity. For 50 years, we have prepared students to lead meaningful lives in a complex world through rigorous academics and authentic learning experiences that build critical thinking, compassion, and real-world problem solving.

With a community representing over 70 nationalities, ISK offers a truly international environment where students develop cultural fluency, strong communication skills, and the confidence to collaborate across differences. From Early Childhood through Grade 12, we nurture engaged learners and thoughtful global citizens ready to shape the future.

At ISK, we don't believe in one-size-fits-all education. Every learner follows a personalized pathway shaped by their passions, talents, and aspirations. We challenge each student and support them in finding their own way to excellence.

pages.title: Mission and Vision - International School of Kenya
blocks: The ISK Mission, Vision, and Educational Aims guide all decisions at the school. These foundational elements define our purpose, the educational beliefs that drive learning, and the specific dispositions we are committed to developing in each student.
At ISK, learning is the construction of meaning. We construct meaning through inquiry-based experiences that transcend disciplines.
The ISK Big 5: Our Framework for Learning
These five active roles define how we approach teaching and learning at ISK. They prepare all our students to become thoughtful, capable individuals ready to make a difference in the world.

As a self-manager, I am responsible for my actions. I reflect on my learning and set goals to continue to grow. I take initiative and persevere to overcome challenges. I am aware of my needs and the needs of others.

As a thinker, I identify problems and find creative solutions. I am curious and pose questions in ways that open up thinking and create new possibilities. I analyze and evaluate information to design and develop solutions and opportunities. I make claims and support them with evidence and reasoning. I deepen my understanding by considering different viewpoints.

As a collaborator, I actively listen to understand the ideas of others. I contribute by asking questions and building on the ideas of others. I ensure that all voices are heard and valued by encouraging others and sometimes compromising as we build on our strengths. I am respectful of others’ opinions and form positive relationships as a community member in order to achieve a common goal.

As a changemaker, I use my skills and understandings to make a positive difference. I am interested in working on real-world problems and being helpful locally and globally. By being aware of my culture and other cultures, I better understand issues from many points of view. I try to make principled decisions in my everyday life and advocate for a just and equitable future.

As a communicator, I express ideas and information clearly, confidently, and appropriately. I listen and show respect when others are speaking. I express my true self and understand that my words impact others. I support and provide space for those whose voices and identities may not be heard.
Whether you are exploring international education for your child, considering joining our faculty, or interested in partnering with ISK, we invite you to experience what makes us special.

pages.title: Welcome to Kenya's Top International School - ISK
blocks: Rooted in Community. Ready for the World.

Founded in 1976 through a partnership between the governments of the United States and Canada, the International School of Kenya (ISK) is a private, nonprofit school serving PreK through Grade 12. Located on a 40-acre campus in Nairobi, ISK is home to nearly 1,100 students representing more than 70 nationalities, creating a vibrant and globally minded learning community.

A rigorous international curriculum where learning is inspired by ambition, curiosity, passion, and creativity. We equip each student with the tools to become confident leaders and changemakers ready for the world. Why ISK: IB World School excellence (70% IB Diploma) + North American accreditation + admission to the world's most competitive universities + a challenging, joyful, and supportive learning environment.
Education at ISK extends far beyond textbooks and traditional lessons. We prepare students to think critically, lead with purpose, and make a positive impact in their communities and beyond.
We believe true learning happens when students step outside the classroom and into the real world. That's why we're committed to nurturing:
Critical Thinkers: Students who question, analyze, and solve complex problems with intellectual rigor
Changemakers: Young leaders who identify challenges and create meaningful solutions
Collaborators: Students who work effectively with others to achieve shared goals
Communicators: Confident voices ready to articulate ideas and inspire action
Self-Managers: Individuals who take ownership of their growth and well-being

Today's challenges demand more than knowledge—they require purpose-driven action. Our students graduate prepared not just for university, but for the opportunities and challenges of tomorrow. They understand that learning is a lifelong journey, and they're equipped with the character and capabilities to lead it.

ISK is internationally recognized by the world's leading accrediting agencies and educational organizations. Our rigorous accreditations and memberships reflect our commitment to maintaining the highest global standards of educational excellence.
